'''Tyuth''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who served the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. He learned of [[Elric Organa]] betraying the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] and tasked a Republic citizen to either apprehend or kill him.
